dataset: CWRU Bearing Data Center - 12k Drive End Bearing Fault Data + Normal Baseline
units: raw stored accelerometer values as distributed by CWRU (g); no resampling, filtering, normalisation or truncation applied
subset_rationale: Full 4-load x 3-fault-type factorial at 0.007" and 0.014" fault diameters, plus all four normal baselines. 0.021"/0.028" and the @3:00/@12:00 outer-race positions were not downloaded to stay inside the size budget.
notes: Outer-race fault position is '@6:00' per the 12k Drive End data table, which labels @6:00 'Centered' with 'Load Zone Centered at 6:00'. The Apparatus/Procedures page instead calls 3 o'clock 'directly in the load zone' and 6 o'clock 'orthogonal to the load zone'. This inconsistency is in the CWRU source documentation, not introduced here. fs_hz=12000 is taken from the CWRU Apparatus/Procedures page ('Digital data was collected at 12,000 samples per second'). The Normal Baseline Data page itself does not state a rate for files 97-100, and parts of the literature assume 48 kHz for the normal baseline. Treat fs for the NORMAL files as documented-but-not-explicitly-stated-per-file.

The Apparatus/Procedures page instead calls 3 o'clock 'directly in the load zone' and 6 o'clock 'orthogonal to the load zone'. This inconsistency is in the CWRU source documentation, not introduced here.
